title: The Syllabus Modernizer
description: Takes an existing syllabus and produces a revised version — clearer learning objectives, modernized tone, aligned assignments, updated policies — while preserving the faculty member's voice.
framing_paragraph: This recipe defines The Syllabus Modernizer, a teaching-focused agent that fits the use case in the description above. Use it when that description matches what you want the agent to do in your course. The agent works best when its Instructions field is calibrated against two or three representative prompts before you share the resulting agent with students or colleagues.
